links.outcome: Clinician-rated document quality of AI scribe notes (modified PDQI-9 domains)
links.effect: Median score 4 on a 1-5 scale in 9 of 10 survey domains (n = 77), indicating acceptable quality; mean SUS 74.
links.quote: The document quality survey showed acceptable document quality with median score 4, in 9 of the 10 survey domains (scale 1-to-5, n = 77).

screen.reason: Empirical cohort study of real-world deployment of an ambient AI medical scribe assessing documentation efficiency, quality, and clinician well-being without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard variation.
